tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Search for mountain routes on Camptocamp.org by keyword, by area (area_id from search_areas), or both; at least one is required. Returns a list of matching routes with basic info (ID, title, activities, elevation, rating).

query.description: Search query for routes (e.g. 'Mont Blanc voie normale')

area_id.description: Camptocamp area ID from search_areas (e.g. 14403 for Écrins)

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get full details of a specific route from Camptocamp.org by its ID, including description, ratings, elevation data, gear requirements, and the areas it belongs to (range, admin_limits, country). Area IDs can be passed as area_id to search_routes, search_waypoints and search_outings.

tools.name: search_waypoints
tools.description: Search for waypoints (summits, shelters, huts, bivouacs) on Camptocamp.org by keyword, by area (area_id from search_areas), or both; at least one is required. Returns a list of matching waypoints with basic info (ID, title, type, elevation).

query.description: Search query for waypoints (e.g. 'Mont Blanc', 'refuge Goûter')

area_id.description: Camptocamp area ID from search_areas (e.g. 14403 for Écrins)

tools.name: get_waypoint
tools.description: Get full details of a specific waypoint from Camptocamp.org by its ID, including altitude, GPS coordinates, description, and the areas it belongs to (range, admin_limits, country). Area IDs can be passed as area_id to search_routes, search_waypoints and search_outings.

tools.name: search_user_outings
tools.description: List outings (trip reports) published by a Camptocamp user. Returns outings with ID, title, activities, date, elevation, and rating. Use the user_id from the Camptocamp profile URL (e.g. u=430052).

user_id.description: Camptocamp user ID (e.g. 430052 for username o.laurendeau)

tools.name: get_outing
tools.description: Get full details of a specific outing (trip report) from Camptocamp.org by its ID, including description, conditions, weather, participants, and associated routes.

tools.name: search_outings
tools.description: Search outings (trip reports) across all of Camptocamp.org, most recent first (by end date, keyword searches included). All filters are optional and combine with AND: query (keyword), area_id (from search_areas), activity, date_from / date_to (YYYY-MM-DD; an outing matches if its date range overlaps the requested range — give one bound only for 'since' / 'until'), route_id (from search_routes), waypoint_id (from search_waypoints). Each result shows ID, title, activities, dates, condition rating, difficulty ratings, max elevation, elevation gain, mountain ranges and author. Use offset to page (offset + limit ≤ 10,000). An unknown area/route/waypoint ID yields no results, not an error. Call get_outing with an ID for the full conditions, weather and report text.

area_id.description: Camptocamp area ID from search_areas (e.g. 14409 for Vanoise)

activity.description: Activity, one of: skitouring, snow_ice_mixed, mountain_climbing, rock_climbing, ice_climbing, hiking, snowshoeing, paragliding, mountain_biking, via_ferrata, slacklining

date_from.description: Earliest date (YYYY-MM-DD); matches outings whose date range ends on or after it

date_to.description: Latest date (YYYY-MM-DD); matches outings whose date range starts on or before it

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (offset + limit ≤ 10,000)

tools.name: search_areas
tools.description: Search Camptocamp.org areas by name (titles match in any language, fuzzily — check the returned titles; towns are not areas, search the range or département instead). area_type: range = mountain range/massif; admin_limits = administrative subdivision such as a French département or Swiss canton; country = country. Returns ID, title and type. Pass the returned ID as area_id to search_routes, search_waypoints and search_outings.

area_type.description: Restrict to one area type: range, admin_limits or country

tools.name: get_area
tools.description: Get a Camptocamp.org area by ID: title, type, summary and description as published (Camptocamp markup included). No geometry, no route count; use search_routes / search_waypoints with area_id for those.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search books (guidebooks/topos, history, novels, photo books, technique) on Camptocamp.org by title keyword. The query matches book TITLES only: searching by author name or ISBN is unreliable and can return unrelated books or nothing, so an empty result does not mean the book does not exist. Returns ID, title, author, book types and activities; use get_book for editor, date, ISBN and covered routes/waypoints.

query.description: Search query matched against book titles (e.g. 'Vallot', 'Mont Blanc')

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Get full details of a specific book from Camptocamp.org by its ID: author, editor, publication date, ISBN, pages, languages, website, book types, activities, summary, description, the routes and waypoints it covers, and its related articles (with IDs for get_route, get_waypoint and get_article). Values are shown exactly as Camptocamp stores them; missing fields are left out.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Camptocamp.org articles by keyword. Articles cover gear, climbing and mountaineering techniques, mountain environment (avalanches, snow, weather), stories, and topoguide supplements (route lists, useful links). Each result shows article_type: `collab` (community-edited reference) or `personal` (one author's view, not community consensus), plus categories and activities. Use get_article for the full text and linked routes, waypoints, articles, outings and books.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a Camptocamp.org article by ID: full text (Camptocamp markup kept as is), summary, author, type (collab/personal), categories, activities, quality, and the IDs of associated routes, waypoints, articles, outings and books, which can be followed with get_route, get_waypoint, get_article, get_outing and get_book. The Language line gives the language of the returned text (fr when available, otherwise another locale).
